text:
kevin: heads-up — observed p99 spike on /chat/generate at ~09:12 UTC, p99 went from ~350ms -> ~1.2s. throughput steady.

maria: alerted. any recent selector/batching/KV changes?

kevin: flamegraph points heavy time in ToolCallHandler::wait_for_response and decode_step. KV hit-rate for long-seq requests (>800 tokens) dropped ~92% -> ~68% in the window.

sam: we rolled kernel selector yesterday to prefer tiled-attn when seq>512 to optimize avg. could be mis-triggering for sparse long prompts.

jade: note: one partner uses an in-generation sync tool chain (several tool.call()s inside decode hooks). if those are blocking, they amplify tail latency.

kevin: traces show 3-6 sync tool calls per generation, each 100-400ms. when microbatches coalesce tool-heavy sessions onto same worker, p99 multiplies.

maria: mitigation ideas: revert selector, short-circuit tool-blocking via runtime flag for affected customers, increase KV prefetch/TTL, or push async tool-call path.

kevin: replayed locally — reverting selector drops p99 to ~420ms; async-tool PoC in sim gets p99 ~280ms; KV prefetch helps p95 but not p99.

jade: quick action: add runtime guard `disable_tool_blocking=true` for customer B and canary rollback selector.

infra-bot: deploy queued: canary rollback runtime-selector v1.23 -> v1.22 by @jade. ETA 8m :gear:

sam: also adding lightweight telemetry: tag requests `has_tool_calls=true` and track per-customer p95/p99 so we catch recurrences.

kevin: filing follow-ups: PERF-4221 kernel-selector regression, PERF-4222 async-tool-call PoC + API contract, PERF-4223 KV prefetch tuning. will attach traces/repro and blocked stacks.

maria: longer term: update kernel selector heuristic to consider tool_call_count and kv_hit_estimate; change microbatching to avoid grouping tool-heavy sessions.

jade: monitoring canary. will roll if green. :thumbsup:

kevin: profiling command I used:
```
rio debug profile --service=runtime-0 --since=2026-03-15T09:10:00Z --until=2026-03-15T09:30:00Z --flamegraph > flame.svg
```

sam: nice catch — keeping this thread for rollout status and postmortem notes.

jade: ping when canary finishes.

kevin: will update PERF tickets with artifacts. end thread.
